summary: Typed table engine: sorting, search, filters, selection, and pagination, in local or server-controlled mode. Uses Table styles.
whenNotToUse: Static data without interaction: use Table.
Tens of thousands of rows locally: paginate on the server (no virtualization).

props.name: columns
props.description: id, header, accessor, cell, sortable, sortFn, searchable, isRowHeader, align, minWidth, hideHeader.

props.name: rows
props.description: Local: all rows. Server: only the current page.

props.name: mode
props.description: In server mode the component reports state changes and does not reprocess rows.

props.name: totalRows
props.description: Server: total number of rows matching the filters.

props.name: searchable, search / defaultSearch / onSearchChange
props.description: Search field in the toolbar (case- and accent-insensitive in local mode).

props.name: filter
props.description: Local: predicate for your filter controls.

props.name: isFiltered / onClearFilters
props.description: Distinguishes “no results” from “no data” and clears the filters.

props.name: page, pageSize, pageSizeOptions…
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled pagination; paginated={false} disables it.

props.name: selectionMode, selectedIds / defaultSelectedIds / onSelectionChange
props.description: Selection is preserved across pages; “select all” acts on the visible page.

props.name: isLoading, error, onRetry, emptyState, noResultsState
props.description: Loading, error, no data, and no results states.

keyboard.action: Move focus between rows and cells (grid pattern).
On a sortable header: sorts. On a row: onRowAction.
Leaves the grid toward the toolbar and pagination.

accessibility: WAI-ARIA grid pattern via react-aria; aria-sort on sorted columns.
Selection checkboxes with localized names; selection count and row range announced as status.
Each state (error, empty, loading) has explicit text, not just icons or colors.
Missing values are shown as “—” and always sorted last.
responsive: Strategy: localized horizontal scroll with a row header column; toolbar and footer wrap.
For mobile, reduce columns (computed columns prop) or offer a card view.
customization: cell for custom rendering; sortFn for specific sorting; className/style.
commonMistakes: Passing all rows in server mode: pass only the page and totalRows.
Using the index as getRowId: the selection shifts after sorting or filtering.
Creating new columns on every render without useMemo in very large tables.

examples.name: LocalFilters
examples.title: Filters, search, selection, and bulk actions
examples.description: Removal only affects the example's local state.

examples.name: ServerSide
examples.title: Server mode (simulated)
examples.description: Latency and errors simulated locally: replace fakeFetch with your API.

examples.name: CompactSticky
examples.title: Compact, striped, sticky header, and single selection
examples.description: Without pagination, with a max height; suspended customers are disabled and missing dates show a dash.

limits: “Select all” is limited to the visible page.
